description.value: The Hide Out Cafe is a Fair Trade, organic coffee shop and fresh-food lunch spot in downtown New Westminster, serving locally-roasted coffee from Continental Coffee in Vancouver alongside house-made paninis, wraps, salads, and soups. Situated on Carnarvon Street across from the New Westminster Law Courts, it offers both indoor seating and a patio in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. Touring cyclists will find a solid mid-day stop with a broad menu including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free choices, plus free Wi-Fi and takeout service.
